body:
31 Oct, Karolis: 'Pet shop counter is facing wall, needs to face coming in customers. Others approved.'
Floor 3 path fix: OK'd by Karolis.
COUNTER (book v151): it stood front-right with its front to the front wall. Now it stands along the right wall at (5.5, 2.4), front (paw + 'Pet Shop' sign) facing the middle of the shop and the door; the shopkeeper stands behind it, facing the customers. Free path all round (walk check: floor 1 100% reachable; staff get behind it from the front end). Reviewer 8/10.
Pick in Model Compare → Pet Shop inside (🔔).
short: OK'd 31 Oct: free paths, counter faces customers, one tree. In the model pack
source: Karolis 31 Oct: player must move around the shop with no blocked path
title: Pet Shop: counter turned to face the customers (floor 3 path OK'd)
